# odinex_elastic_ip_assignment (Resource)

Assigns an Elastic IP to a server without public IPs. The ID is the Elastic IP ID. Do not set `server_id` on the `odinex_elastic_ip` at the same time.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "odinex_elastic_ip_assignment" "app" {
  elastic_ip_id = odinex_elastic_ip.app.id
  server_id     = odinex_server.app.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `elastic_ip_id` (Number) ID of the Elastic IP.
- `server_id` (Number) ID of the server.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique ID of the resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The ID is the Elastic IP ID.
terraform import odinex_elastic_ip_assignment.app 9
```
